title: asclepias peltigera
intro: Asclepias peltigera, commonly known as Butterfly Weed or Orange Milkweed, is a perennial plant belonging to the Apocynaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and fighting off infections due to its antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Asclepias peltigera include anti-inflammatory and antiviral activities, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides, flavonoids, and saponins, although further research is needed to fully understand its pharmacological properties.
